objects.name: CARROTBALL
objects.description: [CARROTBALL](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0465) is an FTP downloader utility that has been in use since at least 2019. [CARROTBALL](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0465) has been used as a downloader to install [SYSCON](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0464).(Citation: Unit 42 CARROTBAT January 2020)
objects.description_fa: [CARROTBALL](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0465) یک ابزار بارگیری FTP است که حداقل از سال 2019 مورد استفاده قرار گرفته است. [CARROTBALL](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0465) به عنوان دانلودکننده برای نصب استفاده شده است. [SYSCON](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0464).(Citation: Unit 42 CARROTBAT January 2020)
